description: EPH-02 CRITICAL PRE-EXECUTION SIMULATION GATEWAY for Flashloans & MEV routes on Base (ChainID 8453). Executes read-only EVM sandbox tracing before broadcasting real arbitrage or swap routes to mainnet. Detects hidden reverts, slippage traps, fee-on-transfer hooks, and gas bombs. Zero host OS privilege, strictly memory-isolated. Charges 1.50 USDC via x402 on Base. Supply payer_address. For redemption pass invoice_id and signature in _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain payment or method=points where supported. Settlement errors set isError and _meta.x402/payment-error.status_code; 503 indicates admission unavailable, while a 409 uncertain outcome must not be automatically retried.
